title: Cold, wet hiker who cannot stop shaking

lay_descriptions: My friend is soaked from the rain and can't stop shaking. She keeps tripping over nothing.
He's freezing and mumbling, and he's acting kind of drunk but we haven't had anything to drink.
We got caught in cold rain for hours. My hiking partner is shaking really badly and seems out of it.

conversation.question: What happened?
conversation.answer: We've been hiking in cold rain for several hours. My friend is soaked, can't stop shaking, and keeps stumbling.

title: Desert hiker confused in the heat

lay_descriptions: My dad is burning up and talking nonsense. We've been out in the sun all day.
She sat down on the trail and won't answer properly. Her skin is really hot and it's over 100 degrees out here.
My buddy got a bad headache in the heat and now he's confused and wobbly.

conversation.question: What happened?
conversation.answer: We've been hiking in the desert since morning. My partner has a pounding headache, feels very hot, and has started saying things that don't make sense.

title: Blow to the head from rockfall

presentation.chief_complaint: hit on the head by a rock
lay_descriptions: A rock came down and hit my climbing partner in the head. He was out for maybe a minute and now he's thrown up twice.
She got knocked on the head and keeps asking me the same question over and over.
My friend took a rock to the helmet. He says he's fine but he seems dazed and his headache is getting worse.

conversation.question: What happened?
conversation.answer: A falling rock hit my partner on the head. He blacked out for about a minute, and now he has a bad headache and has vomited twice.

title: Rolled ankle with the cold setting in

lay_descriptions: My son rolled his ankle and can't put any weight on it. It's getting dark and he's starting to shiver.
I twisted my ankle badly and heard a pop. It's swelling up fast and I'm five miles from the car.
Her ankle is huge and purple and she can't walk. We don't have much warm gear and it's getting cold.

conversation.question: What happened?
conversation.answer: My son twisted his ankle on a rocky section. It's swollen and he can't put weight on it. It's getting cold and dark and he's started shivering.

title: Bee sting with a swelling throat

lay_descriptions: My wife got stung by a bee and now her lips are swelling and she says her throat feels tight.
He's covered in hives after a wasp sting and he's wheezing.
I got stung and I'm allergic. My throat feels funny and I'm getting itchy all over.

conversation.question: What happened?
conversation.answer: My friend was stung by a bee ten minutes ago. Her face is swelling, she has hives, and she says it's getting hard to breathe. She has an EpiPen in her pack.

lay_descriptions: A rattlesnake just bit my brother on the calf. Should I cut it and suck the poison out?
Something bit my ankle in the brush and I think it was a snake. There are two holes and it's swelling.
My friend got bitten by a snake. Do I tie something tight above the bite?

conversation.question: What happened?
conversation.answer: A snake bit my brother on the lower leg a few minutes ago. There are two puncture marks and it's already swelling. Should I tie it off or try to suck the venom out?

title: Deep axe cut to the thigh

presentation.chief_complaint: heavy bleeding from a leg wound
lay_descriptions: The axe slipped and went into his leg. There's blood everywhere and it won't stop.
I cut my thigh really deep chopping wood and it's bleeding a lot. I'm getting dizzy.
She has a huge gash on her leg and the blood is soaking through everything we put on it.

conversation.question: What happened?
conversation.answer: My friend cut his thigh with an axe while splitting wood. Blood is pouring out and soaking through the shirt I'm holding on it.

lay_descriptions: My husband just dropped on the trail and he's not breathing. What do I do?
A man in our group collapsed. He won't wake up and he's only gasping every so often.
She grabbed her chest and fell over. I can't wake her.

conversation.question: What happened?
conversation.answer: An older man in our hiking group just collapsed. He doesn't respond when I shake him and I don't think he's breathing.
